verdict.rationale: n8n publishes a documented public REST API (n8n-docs-16, docs.n8n.io/connect/n8n-api) allowing programmatic control of workflows, credentials, and executions, alongside CLI (n8n-docs-17) and webhook triggers (n8n-docs-21) for driving the product externally. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s at standard paths), and independent/hands-on community confirmation of API usage.
